title: Gated model onboarding and performance profile curation pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create an end-to-end CI/CD pipeline that takes a model artifact from build through cryptographic attestation and staged profile publication. The pipeline should run reproducible builds, sign artifacts with customer/team KMS-backed keys, validate perf manifests against a golden prompt set, publish verified performance profiles to the catalog, and orchestrate a staged rollout (canary -> ramp -> full) with automatic rollback on regression signals.
background: Current onboarding steps are manual or semi-automated: engineers build model artifacts and upload artifacts and performance manifests separately. Signing and profile publication require manual cli steps and a human gate, which slows onboarding and increases chance of mismatched profile+artifact pairs. We need a deterministic pipeline that enforces provenance, ties perf profiles to specific model hashes, and gives operators safe rollout controls.
goals: Deterministic reproducible builds with content-addressable artifact hashes
Automated cryptographic attestation using KMS (cosign or equivalent) and embedded provenance metadata
Automated validation of performance manifests against smoke + golden prompts and threshold-based gating
Publish performance profiles to model catalog atomically with artifact promotion
Support staged rollout with canary monitoring and automatic rollback on quality or latency regressions
acceptance_criteria: Given a model source commit and build config, pipeline produces a signed artifact whose hash is recorded in the model registry
A performance profile is automatically validated (run on canonical dataset) and bound to the artifact hash before being published
Operators can configure rollout policy (canary % , observation window, regression thresholds) and pipeline executes the rollout automatically
If observed downstream metrics cross regression thresholds (latency or perplexity/error on golden prompts), pipeline marks rollout failed and triggers rollback
All actions (build, sign, validate, publish, rollout) produce audit entries with timestamps and KMS key IDs
technical_notes: Use hermetic builder (Nix/BuildKit) to produce bit-for-bit reproducible artifacts and a deterministic manifest file
Leverage cosign with KMS-backed keys for attestation; store signatures in the artifact registry and reference them by digest
Perf validation harness runs a small canonical prompt set (golden_prompts.json) under controlled env; thresholds configurable per-model
Profile publishing writes a performance_manifest with hashed artifact reference and signature; registry enforces atomic publish semantics
Rollout orchestrator talks to Dedicated routing layer to split traffic and to telemetry to fetch SLO signals during observation window
rollout_plan: Stage 1 - Canary: 2% traffic for 30 minutes; collect latency and quality metrics
Stage 2 - Ramp: 20% traffic for 1 hour if Stage 1 passes
Stage 3 - Full: 100% traffic after successful ramp
Automatic rollback: if any metric regresses beyond configured threshold during observation window, revert to previous pinned artifact and republish profile with failure reason
test_plan: Unit tests for build reproducibility (rebuild twice -> identical digest)
Integration test: pipeline end-to-end in staging with fake KMS and artifact registry
Chaos test: simulate signature verification failure and ensure publish is blocked
Canary test: synthetic load against canary target with injected latency/quality degradation to validate rollback path
Audit test: verify every pipeline run emits audit entries and the registry stores signature meta
risks_mitigation: Risk: Key compromise or accidental key rotation. Mitigation: implement key rotation policy, require multistep rotation with no immediate retire, and KMS policy constraints
Risk: False positives in perf validation due to flaky tests. Mitigation: stable golden prompts, multiple runs, and statistical smoothing (p95 over 3 runs)
Risk: Rollout causes production incidents. Mitigation: small initial canary, short observation windows, automated rollback and manual abort hooks

blocking_issues: KMS policy booth: restricted KMS key permissions currently block cosign from signing in CI (security needs to approve a limited service account)
Registry contract: registry API needs an atomic publish endpoint; current API is non-atomic and could race with concurrent publishes
